questions.q: Where do the friends set up camp every year?
questions.e: In the video: "Svake godine početkom avgusta kampujemo u Vlasotincu pored reke" — every year at the beginning of August we camp in Vlasotince by the river.

questions.q: Which year did they skip?
questions.e: In the video: "propustili smo samo jednu godinu, 2020. Tada nismo mogli zbog virusa" — we missed only one year, 2020. We couldn't then because of the virus.

questions.q: Where did David find the barrels for the raft?
o: At a dump on his street
questions.e: In the video: "David ih je našao, pogađajte gde? Na otpadu u njegovoj ulici" — David found them, guess where? At a dump on his street.

questions.q: What were the benches made from?
questions.e: In the video: "on se ponudio da isečemo njegov orah za klupice" — he offered that we cut down his walnut tree for benches.

questions.q: Where did they buy the mattress to sleep on?
o: At the Jysk store in Leskovac
questions.e: In the video: "Ljudi, dobrodošli u Jysk" — after the words "idemo za Leskovac da kupimo dušek za spavanje" (we're going to Leskovac to buy a mattress for sleeping).

questions.q: Where did they get electricity for the camp?
o: They asked permission from the person who provides it every year
They took it from the river
questions.e: In the video: "Pa da vas pitamo da li može opet da uzmemo struju od vas" — "Da, može" — so we wanted to ask whether we can take electricity from you again — "Yes, you can".

questions.q: What unexpected thing happened when everything was ready?
o: They drained the lake by raising the dam
questions.e: In the video: "upravo dižu branu. Znači, jezero u kojem se kupamo... sutra neće biti tu" — they're just raising the dam. So the lake we swim in... won't be there tomorrow.

questions.q: What was on the camping to-do list?
o: Rope jumping, a campfire, a raft, a projector, a lamb
questions.e: In the video: "da zavežemo konopac za skakanje, da napravimo logorsku vatru, ... da napravimo veliki splav, da ispečemo jagnje" — to tie up the jumping rope, to make a campfire, ... to build a big raft, to roast a lamb.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Kupiti buriće za *splav*.
questions.e: Splav — a raft.

questions.q: Kupiti *dušek* za spavanje.
questions.e: Dušek — a mattress.

questions.q: Doneti moj *šator* iz sela.
questions.e: Šator — a tent.

questions.q: David ih je našao na *otpadu*.
questions.e: Otpad — waste; colloquially, a dump.

questions.q: Idemo napolje da kovemo *klinove*.
questions.e: Klin — a wedge, a peg.

questions.q: Si poneo *čekić*?
questions.e: Čekić — a hammer.

questions.q: Otkrili smo što ne radi: *sijalica* izgorela.
questions.e: Sijalica — a light bulb.

questions.q: Upravo dižu *branu*.
questions.e: Brana — a dam.

questions.q: Svake godine kampujemo u ___ pored reke.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u Vlasotincu.

questions.q: Idemo ___ kablove i Davidove stvari.
questions.e: Ići po + accusative means "go to fetch something": idemo po kablove.

questions.q: Propustili smo samo jednu ___.
questions.e: Propustiti what — accusative case: godinu.

questions.q: ___ smo šest komada, biće to dovoljno.
questions.e: A specific quantity bought in one go is perfective: kupili. Kupovali is imperfective (process, regular action). Smo is plural, so not kupio.

questions.q: Sinoć je ___ kiša, sad je već suvo.
questions.e: The participle agrees with the subject: kiša is feminine singular, so pala.

questions.q: Moramo kod ___ koji nam daje struju.
questions.e: Kod requires the genitive case: kod čoveka.

questions.q: Moram u mrklom mraku da idem sad ___ ovu šumu
questions.e: Kroz ("through") + accusative: kroz ovu šumu. Bez, od and do take the genitive.

questions.q: Šta si radio s ___, Davide?
questions.e: S(a) ("with") + instrumental: on → njim. S njim — "with him".
